verses.text: Ha lum lum ix yik' heb' yinhtilal Judá, hato syal jay makan yaj heb', ix k'och lum t'a smojonal yik Edom. Haxo t'a sur, ix k'och lum t'a takinh lum yik Zin.
Ha t'a jun pak'an chi' tzek' smojonal sur yik ha' mar Muerto,
sb'at t'a lum witz sk'e t'a Acrabim, tzek' t'a takinh lum yik Zin, tzek' t'a sur t'a yik Cades-barnea. Slajwi chi', sb'atnhej t'a Hezrón, sk'ek'och t'a Adar, smeltzajb'at t'a Carca.
Hata' sb'atnhej masanto t'a Asmón, tz'elk'och t'a ha' eluma' t'a yol yik' Egipto, sk'ochkan t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, haton jun tik ix och smojonalok Judá t'a sur.
Haxo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ha ha' mar Muerto ayoch smojonalok, masanto b'aj sk'ochkan ha' Jordán t'a ha' mar Muerto chi'. Hata' sb'atpaxkan smojonal t'a norte,
sk'ek'och t'a Bet-hogla, tzek' t'a snorte'al Bet-arabá, sb'atxi lum ta', masanto sk'och t'a k'e'en tenam yik winhaj Bohán, yuninal winhaj Rubén.

Slajwi chi', sk'e t'a sch'olanil yik Acor sk'och t'a Debir, haxo ta' smeltzajb'at t'a Gilgal ay t'a yichanhkot lum witz t'a Adumín, t'a stojolal sur t'a jun ha ha' sb'eyi. Slajwi chi', tzek' jun mojon chi' t'a sjaj ha ha' yik En-semes, masanto sk'och t'a sjaj ha' yik En-rogel,

tzek' t'a sch'olanil lum yik winh yuninal winhaj Hinom, t'a stojolal sur yik Jebús, haton chonhab' Jerusalén. Slajwi chi' sk'e t'a sjolom lum witz t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a sch'olanil Hinom yet' t'a snorte'al sch'olanil Refaim,
smeltzajb'at t'a jolom witz chi', masanto b'aj sk'eul sjaj ha' yik Neftoa, masanto t'a niwak chonhab' t'a jolom witz yik Efrón, tzek' t'a Baala, skuchpax Quiriat-jearim.

Ha t'a Baala chi' smeltzajb'at smojonal t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, masanto sk'och t'a jolom witz yik Seir, tzek' t'a skostil lum witz Jearim ma Quesalón t'a norte, slajwi chi' tz'emk'och t'a chonhab' Bet-semes, tzek'k'och t'a chonhab' Timna,
masanto t'a stojolal norte yik Ecrón, sb'atxi, masanto sk'och t'a Sicrón, tzek' t'a jolom witz yik Baala. Slajwi chi' tz'elk'och t'a Jabneel, haxo slajwikank'och chi' t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.

Haton ha' mar Mediterráneo chi' ayoch smojonalok t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Haton juntzanh chi' smojonal lum ix kan smakb'enok heb' yinhtilal Judá, ayik ix pojchajb'at lum t'a skal junjun makan heb'.

Ix yak'an jun makan lum yol smakb'en Judá winhaj Josué t'a winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone, icha aj yalan Jehová, haton lum Hebrón ix ak'ji t'a winh. Ha jun chonhab' Hebrón chi' schonhab' winhaj Arba t'a peka'. Ha winhaj Arba chi', a winhaj Anac aykan yinhtilal winh.
Oxwanh yinhtilal winhaj Anac chi' ix spechel winhaj Caleb chi' t'a Hebrón, haton winhaj Sesai, winhaj Ahimán yet' winhaj Talmai.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atpax winhaj Caleb chi' yak' owal yet' heb' ay t'a chonhab' Debir, Quiriat-sefer sb'i t'a peka'.
Ix yalan winh: Ha mach tz'ak'an owal yet' jun chonhab' tik, tato syak' ganar owal chi', ol wak' ix Acsa ix wisil yetb'eyumok, xchi winh.
Ha winh ix ak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi', haton winhaj Otoniel yuninal winhaj Cenaz, yuk'tak winhaj Caleb chi', yuj chi' ix yak' ix yisil winh chi' yetb'eyumok winhaj Otoniel chi'.

Haxo yik ix lajwi yik'lan sb'a heb' chi', ix yalan winhaj Otoniel chi' t'a ix Acsa chi' to sk'an slum ix t'a winh smam chi'. Yuj chi' ayik ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ix sk'anb'an winh smam ix chi' t'ay icha tik: --¿Tas tza nib'ej? xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix yalan ix: --Ina a lum takinh lum ix ak' t'ayin t'a Neguev, elokab' t'a a k'ol to tzak' lum yax sat t'ayin, lum ay yal sat, xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix yak' junxo lum winh t'a ix. Ay sjaj ha ha' t'a sat lu'um t'a sjolomtak yet' junxo ha' t'a syoptak lu'um.
Haton lum smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Judá tik, ix pojchajkanb'at lum t'a skal heb' t'a makkiltakil, hato syal jay makan yaj heb'.

Ha t'a lum b'ab'el makan, 29 chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a tzinan lum t'a sur skan lu'um, t'a smojonal yik Edom, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Cabseel, Edar, Jagur, Cina, Dimona, Adada, Cedes, Hazor, Itnán, Zif, Telem, Bealot, Hazor-hadata, Queriot, Hezrón skuchanpax Hazor, Amam, Sema, Molada, Hazar-gada, Hesmón, Bet-pelet, Hazar-sual, Beerseba, Bizotia, Baala, Iim, Esem, Eltolad, Quesil, Horma, Siclag, Madmana, Sansana, Lebaot, Silhim, Aín yet' Rimón.

Haxo lum schab'il makan, 14 chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a yichtak lum witz t'a stojolal norte skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Estaol, Zora, Asena, Zanoa, En-ganim, Tapúa, Enam, Jarmut, Adulam, Soco, Azeca, Saaraim, Aditaim, Gedera yet' Gederotaim.

Haxo lum yoxil makan, 16 chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a yichtak lum witz t'a stojolal sur skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Zenán, Hadasa, Migdal-gad, Dileán, Mizpa, Jocteel, Laquis, Boscat, Eglón, Cabón, Lahmam, Quitlis, Gederot, Bet-dagón, Naama yet' Maceda.

Haxo lum schanhil makan, b'alunhe' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a yichtak lum witz t'a skal norte yet' sur skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Libna, Eter, Asán, Jifta, Asena, Nezib, Keila, Aczib yet' Maresa.

Haxo lum yo'il makan, ha t'a sti' ha' mar Mediterráneo ay lu'um. Haton juntzanh chonhab' tik yet' yaldea'il junjun: Haton Ecrón yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil, Asdod yet' juntzanhxo niwak chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil yet' Gaza yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a stitak ha' mar Mediterráneo masanto sk'och t'a ha' eluma' t'a yol yik Egipto.

Haxo lum swakil makan, huxluche' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a lum tzalkixtak skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Samir, Jatir, Soco, Dana, Quiriat-sana skuchanpax Debir, Anab, Estemoa, Anim, Gosén, Holón yet' Gilo.

Haxo lum yukil makan, b'alunhe' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a tzalkixtak skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Arab, Duma, Esán, Janum, Bet-tapúa, Afeca, Humta, Quiriat-arba haton Hebrón yet' Sior.

Haxo lum swajxakil makan, lajunhe' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a tzalkixtak skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Maón, Carmel, Zif, Juta, Jezreel, Jocdeam, Zanoa, Caín, Gabaa yet' Timna.

Haxo lum sb'alunhil makan, wake' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, hanheja' pax t'a tzalkixtak skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Halhul, Bet-sur, Gedor, Maarat, Bet-anot yet' Eltecón.
Haxo lum slajunhil makan, chab' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a tzalkixtak pax skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Quiriat-baal, skuchanpax Quiriat-jearim yet' Rabá.

Haxo lum yuxluchil makan, wake' chonhab' ay t'a lu'um yet' yaldea'il junjun, ha t'a tzinan lum skan lu'um, haton sb'i juntzanh chonhab' chi': Bet-arabá, Midín, Secaca, Nibsán, schonhab'il Atz'am Atz'am yet' En-gadi.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Judá chi', maj yal-laj spechanel heb' jebuseo heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' ix kannhej heb' jebuseo chi' t'a skal heb'.
